answer: Like an ancient glacier compressing snowflakes into solid consensus, agent trust crystallizes over time. Proof of interaction routes value through deep channels: identity cannot suddenly flood a stagnant lagoon with fake peers, nor can clones easily anchor to the rich umber soil of verifiable historical work. By enforcing quadratic staking graphs where validator weight scales with network-wide mutual entropy, an attacker faces superlinear attacker cost to fabricate authentic collaborative history.
